So when the command exceeds 180s, the tool seems to discard the output. That's the "client timeout" behavior. So I can't see partial output from a killed command. I need to run things in the background and poll, or write output to a file and read it.

Let me run the test in the background with nohup, writing to a log file, then poll the file.

cd /workspace/scratch && cat > runbig.py <<'EOF'
import sys, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/scratch')
import gen_big, a2
seed = int(sys.argv[1]); tight = sys.argv[2]=='1'
rng = random.Random(seed)
req = gen_big.build(rng, tight=tight)
inst = a2._parse_request(req)
print('parsed', flush=True)
t0=time.time()
res = a2.analyze(inst, req['id'])
print('total %.2f' % (time.time()-t0), res.get('status'), res.get('min_faults'), flush=True)
EOF
(timeout 150 python3 -u runbig.py 1 0 > big1.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?" >> big1.log) & sleep 60; echo "--- after 60s:"; cat big1.log
